spans.text: TensorFlow provides a variety of initialization methods both in the root module and the `keras.initializers` module.

:begin_tab:`jax` By default, Flax initializes weights using `jax.nn.initializers.lecun_normal`, i.e., by drawing samples from a truncated normal distribution centered on 0 with the standard deviation set as the squared root of $1 / \textrm{fan}_{\textrm{in}}$ where `fan_in` is the number of input units in the weight tensor.
